newsitem.title: GHANA: Thin Ghana bourse little changed, CFAO only mover.
newsitem.headline: Thin Ghana bourse little changed, CFAO only mover.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index ended little changed on Monday in thin trade with trading company CFAO CFAO.GH as the only mover.
CFAO gained two cedis to 20 cedis.
The GSE all-share index rose 0.08 points to 363.40 points from 363.32 on Friday.
Just 11,950 shares changed hands compared to 31,200 shares on Friday. Bids outpaced offers by 3,800,630 to 447,550.
